notes: Synthetic, from platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors (429 rate_limit_error) and docs/en/api/rate-limits (the retry-after header in seconds and the anthropic-ratelimit-{requests,tokens,input-tokens,output-tokens}-{limit,remaining,reset} headers, reset as RFC 3339); organization ID, limits and request_id invented. Inducing a 429 would mean exhausting a real organization's limit, so it is not recordable.

sanity_gaps.reason: known gap X3: the retry-after header (and every anthropic-ratelimit-* header) is dropped; models.APIError has no retry field, so the gateway's retry, failover and the client's backoff ignore when Anthropic says to come back
